messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 Alert — kv-cache continuous-batching surge detected in eu-west-1. Token-rate spike + mem fragmentation. Autoscaling triggered. Pager sent to on-call. Logs show repeated cudaMalloc failures.

pagerduty: Paging Devon L (oncall). Incident created: INC-2026-0423-kv-batch-surge. Please ack.

Devon L: acked. looking now. seeing high 5xxs from model-workers pool-173. latency 95p jumped from 180ms -> 1200ms. GPU mem fragmentation metrics spiking.

Devon L: quick snapshot of alarms: continuous_batching.queue_depth up 6x, kv_cache.free_slots down to 8%. cudaMalloc Fragmentation warnings in node-17.

Maria G: adding context — we rolled quantized-2.1 last night, but this looks like allocator fragmentation (pytorch/cuda malloc) + continuous batching combining many large requests. likely working set blowup.

Ajay P: can we flip continuous batching off for affected service as a hot rollback? that should drop cooperative batching pressure and reduce KV growth. also reduce max_batch_tokens.

Devon L: preparing quick override. applying config change to runtime config in eu-west-1.

Devon L: command run: 
```bash
redwoodctl runtime set-config --cluster eu-west-1 --service model-workers 
  --patch '{"continuous_batching.enabled":false,"continuous_batching.max_batch_tokens":256}'
```

deploy-bot: config patch applied to service model-workers in eu-west-1 (change-id: cfg-9032). Starting rolling restart of pods.

Omar R: seeing immediate drop in queue_depth. nice. but still some OOMs from older processes holding slabs. we should run arena compaction on those hosts.

Devon L: running compaction script on node-17 and node-19.

Devon L: compaction command: 
```bash
ssh gpu-node-17 "sudo /opt/redwood/bin/arena_compact --target=aggressive --max-retries=2"
```

Devon L: log snippet: 
```
[2026-04-23T14:12:06Z] arena_compact: freed 2.3GB fragmented slabs
[2026-04-23T14:12:09Z] arena_compact: waiting for cuda context reset
[2026-04-23T14:12:12Z] arena_compact: success
```

Ajay P: also bumping allocator tunables to reduce splitting: `PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=max_split_size_mb:128,garbage_collection_threshold:0.7` on the host env for the short term. will monitor.

Lena C: customer-impact summary — a subset of high-throughput customers in EU saw transient 502s for ~12-15 minutes. support already notified top 5 customers with mitigation note.

Omar R: perf graphs: model-worker error-rate peaked at 9.4% -> now down to 0.8% after config flip + compaction. latency 95p back to ~210ms.

Devon L: observed a secondary issue: continuous batching internal counters didn't drain cleanly and left oversized KV blobs. I rotated KV compaction job to run immediate pass.

Devon L: compaction job: `curl -XPOST https://ops-api/internal/kv/compact?scope=pool-173` -> returned 202.

Maria G: good catch. followup: we should add a guard in the runtime to reject extremely large combined batch sizes (e.g., >1e6 tokens) to prevent runaway growth if continuous batching re-enabled.

Ajay P: opening hotfix PR to add defensive check + config flag to cap combined_batch_tokens. PR-4321. canary will be eu-west-1-small.

deploy-bot: canary deploy PR-4321 to eu-west-1-small started. commit sha: b3c7f9a.

Devon L: monitoring canary. metrics look normal so far for 10m. no regressions.

Omar R: quick root-cause notes for postmortem: combination of recent quantized model change increasing per-token memory, continuous-batching merging larger-than-expected requests, and allocator split behavior under PyTorch CUDA causing fragmentation that prevented mesos of reuse.

Lena C: did any customers see data loss?

Devon L: no data loss. higher tail latency and 502s due to workers failing healthchecks briefly. support sent initial customer communication.

Maria G: follow-ups required:
- revert continuous batching default until we have caps and better heuristics
- add runtime guard for combined_batch_tokens
- schedule allocator tuning run and add arena compaction to routine maintenance windows
- add more telemetry around KV lifetime/slot churn

Ajay P: noted. I'll own the runtime guard + PR. Omar will collaborate on metrics. Maria to schedule maintenance window with infra.

Devon L: current status — incident mitigated. continuous batching disabled in eu-west-1. compaction run. canary of hotfix looks ok. keeping pager open for 30 more mins to observe. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident status changed: Mitigated. Severity downgraded to SEV3.

Devon L: closing out in 30. preparing blameless postmortem doc and timeline. will include relevant logs and commands.

Lena C: thanks folks. please paste customer notification text when ready so support can send final follow-up.

Devon L: customer note draft: 
"We experienced a transient degradation in EU on Apr 23 affecting some high-throughput customers. Root cause: allocator fragmentation combined with continuous-batching merging large requests after a recent model change. We mitigated by disabling continuous batching, running compaction, and deploying a runtime guard. No customer data was lost. We're scheduling follow-up tuning and a permanent fix. Apologies for the disruption."

deploy-bot: canary to eu-west-1-small promoted to full rollout in eu-west-1 (deploy-id: dpl-7789).

Devon L: final: errors remained low for 25m post-rollout, 95p latency stable. marking as resolved. will file postmortem link when ready. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident resolved. Postmortem pending.
